headline: PHI @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.30 at SDP 3.66, with a projected total of 6.96. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: PHI moved -1.17 runs while SDP moved +0.30, changing the projected margin by -1.47 runs. The projected total fell -0.87, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +24.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Randy Vásquez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Andujar, Brandon Marsh, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García, Justin Crawford because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
